source_row.stem: OSHA requires healthcare employers to implement "engineering controls" for sharps safety. An example of an engineering control is:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Reducing how many staff members are permitted to perform injections on a given unit","B":"Staff training alone, without any accompanying change to the physical device being used","C":"Simply posting a written warning sign near the area where injections are given","D":"A safety-engineered needle device with a self-sheathing or retractable mechanism"}}
source_row.rationale: Engineering controls refer to devices that isolate or remove a hazard, such as safety-engineered needles with self-sheathing or retractable mechanisms, required by OSHA to reduce needlestick injury risk.
source_row.source_name: OSHA — Bloodborne Pathogens Standard, Engineering Controls
